name: pytest

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/*"
      - "pymc_extras/**"
      - "tests/**"
      - "setup.py"
      - "pyproject.toml"
      - "conda-envs/**"
      - "codecov.yml"

# Cancels all previous workflow runs for pull requests that have not completed.
concurrency:
  # The concurrency group contains the workflow name and the branch name for pull requests
  # or the commit hash for any other events.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.head_ref || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# Bump CACHE_NUMBER to force a one-time refresh of the cached conda environments.
env:
  CACHE_NUMBER: 1

jobs:
  pre-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97  # v7.0.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      # no-commit-to-branch fails on push to main since HEAD is main. CI lints,
      # it doesn't commit, so skip that one hook.
      - uses: pre-commit/action@2c7b3805fd2a0fd8c1884dcaebf91fc102a13ecd  # v3.0.1
        env:
          SKIP: no-commit-to-branch

  ubuntu:
    needs: pre-commit
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest]
        linker: [cvm, numba]
        python-version: ["3.12"]
        # Shards are balanced by measured runtime under numba, about 12-14 minutes each.
        test-subset:
          - tests/model
          - tests/distributions tests/statespace/core/test_forward_sampling.py
          - tests --ignore tests/model --ignore tests/statespace --ignore tests/distributions --ignore tests/inference/pathfinder
          - tests/statespace/models/test_VARMAX.py tests/statespace/models/test_SARIMAX.py
          - tests/statespace/models tests/statespace/core/test_statespace.py --ignore tests/statespace/models/test_VARMAX.py --ignore tests/statespace/models/test_SARIMAX.py
          - tests/statespace/filters/test_kalman_filter.py
          - tests/statespace --ignore tests/statespace/models --ignore tests/statespace/core/test_statespace.py --ignore tests/statespace/filters/test_kalman_filter.py --ignore tests/statespace/core/test_forward_sampling.py
      fail-fast: false
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      TEST_SUBSET: ${{ matrix.test-subset }}
      PYTENSOR_FLAGS: linker=${{ matrix.linker }}
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -leo pipefail {0}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
      - uses: mamba-org/setup-micromamba@f457c30a868e4760d3a6fcea5f25dc655b8edf39  # v3.2.1
        with:
          environment-file: conda-envs/environment-test.yml
          create-args: >-
            python=${{matrix.python-version}}
          environment-name: pymc-extras-test
          init-shell: bash
          cache-environment: true
          cache-environment-key: pymc-extras-test-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.python-version }}-${{ hashFiles('conda-envs/environment-test.yml') }}-${{ env.CACHE_NUMBER }}
      - name: Install pymc-extras
        run: |
          pip install -e ".[dev]" --no-deps

          python --version
          pip check
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest --color=yes -vv --cov=pymc_extras --cov-append --cov-report=xml --cov-report term --durations=50 $TEST_SUBSET
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/code

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
